purpose: Teach: コロコロ/サブタイトル/タイツ/トラバ/スバ/ジモン/背番号/ケタ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがコロコロ転がるおもちゃを買って下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is going to buy you that rolling toy.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Voice carries the quiet pleasure of sharing good news. Slightly lifted at the end—inviting him to be happy about it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと映画のサブタイトル一覧見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a movie subtitles list with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, earnest delivery. Small boy eager to share something he did with his father. Quick pace, open vowels. Seeking approval and connection.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがママに新しいタイツを下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father gave me new tights.
lines.style: Soft, observational tone. Not boasting—sharing a small domestic moment. Gentle smile underneath the words. The kind of thing she notices and files away.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと「ブログのトラバ、つまりトラックバック」見学したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I looked at a blog trackback—you know, a trackback.
lines.style: Proud clarification in his voice. Child carefully explaining a grown-up thing he learned. Slightly breathless with the effort of getting it right. Wants her to understand.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがフィジーのスバ旅行を計画されてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is planning a trip to Suva, Fiji.
lines.style: Calm, thoughtful delivery. Each phrase lands separately—she's processing as she speaks. Slight wonder in how she mentions it, like she's still getting used to the idea herself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと寺門ジモンの番組観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched that show with Dad—the Jimon Terajima one.
lines.style: Quick, animated. Child naming something specific he knows Mom might know. Building a bridge between his world with Dad and his world with her. Light and connected.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「サッカー観戦は背番号で選手を覚える」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was saying how he remembers soccer players by their jersey numbers.
lines.style: Neutral, relaying information. But underneath—a fondness for how his mind works, for noticing these small patterns. Her voice carries the weight of knowing him well.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと「ケタ違いに大きな数」の話したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad explained those really, really big numbers to me.
lines.style: Satisfied, warm close. Child processing something larger-than-life and proud he understood it. Voice carries the afterglow of a good conversation. Settling into the memory.
